competitors.description: Seed / known competitor set (expected category map; not URLs). Keep adding names up front. Deterministic regex uses this list for competitor_mentions and vendors_in_search_queries. Post-run LLM extract still discovers names absent from this list; those are flagged as surprises. Duplicate seeds that are synonyms (Amazon/AWS API Gateway, Azure APIM/Management) collapse to one canonical vendor.

competitor_aliases.description: Optional canonical name → extra spellings. Prefer one display (e.g. Amazon API Gateway) and list AWS API Gateway / amazon api gateway here. Duplicate seeds still collapse even without this map.

class.description: watch = keep measuring an incumbent/knowledge trap. focus = search-likely and/or product-fit (AEO work goes here).

why.description: Short tag, e.g. knowledge_trap, search_likely, product_fit, search_likely+product_fit.

enabled.description: Default true. Never set watch queries to false.
